drafted_from: tool:list-a-spaces-members's own row (its words, input schema, sample runs and steps) and what its sample runs answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "List who is in a shared space, by the name each chose to show, with their type; only members may ask", with {"space":"sample-club","subject":"owner@example.com"}. It runs tool:list-a-spaces-members and answers {"space":"sample-club","members":[{"member_id":"owner@example.com","name":null,"member_type":"owner","member_type_label":"Owner","state":"member","joined_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (record:space, record:space-member, payment-event, record:commercial-offer, access-grant, access-effect-rule, effect-lifecycle) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List who is in a shared space, by the name each chose to show, with their type; only members may ask", and give it space (The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (The person, the way the space and your access rules name them).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-a-spaces-members and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Lists the space's record:space-member rows: each person's id, the name they chose to show (never a contact), their member type and its label, and whether they count now (the same reader as tool:check-someone-is-in-a-space, over one read of what people hold).

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:space (records:read); record:space-member (records:read, records:list); payment-event (records:list); record:commercial-offer (records:list); access-grant (records:list); access-effect-rule (records:list); effect-lifecycle (records:list).

worked_examples.title: List a space's members on its own sample
worked_examples.ask: List who is in a shared space, by the name each chose to show, with their type; only members may ask
worked_examples.given: The input {"space":"sample-club","subject":"owner@example.com"}, with 2 example rows (record:space, record:space-member) already kept.
